title: Productized Talks at Quidgest
description: Join us on April 16th in Lisbon for the **Productized Talks**, this is where product leaders and enthusiasts come together to connect, explore, and share insights. This edition of Productized Talks hosted by Quidgest brings together **Guida Marques Pinto (Business Director at Worten)** and **Beatriz Rovaris (Product Manager at Quidgest)** for an evening of sharp insights and real product stories. From navigating challenges in product management to building meaningful careers, they’ll share hard-earned lessons and their perspectives. 🚀 Expect candid takes, practical advice, and inspiration for your own product journey. 👉 Join the product community of Lisbon. 🎤 Our Speakers **Beatriz Rovaris, Product Manager at Quidgest** Beatriz Cesa Rovaris is an engineer and product manager with experience in innovation and technology. Passionate about collaborating in teams and leading impactful projects, Beatriz is actively involved in organizations that promote women’s leadership and encourage the creation of more inclusive environments in the tech sector. With a strategic vision and a focus on results, she combines technical expertise with the ability to transform ideas into innovative solutions, driving positive and meaningful change in the market. **The Talk** **When building is free, what's left to build?** The cost of building software is dropping faster than anyone expected. Teams that took months to deliver are now shipping in days. But more speed doesn't mean better products, it means the bottleneck has moved. In this talk, Beatriz explores what changes for product managers when execution is no longer the constraint, and why the most valuable skill in product might not be what you think. **Guida Marques Pinto, Business Director at Worten** Guida is Business Director at Worten, Portugal’s largest consumer electronics retailer, and part of Sonae Group, where she leads the repairs, installations and subscriptions businesses across tech and home services. After several years living in China and the UK, she returned to Portugal and has since worked across several Sonae companies in media, consultancy, and retail, building experience in e-commerce, innovation, digital transformation and the development of subscription-based products and services. **The Talk** **The Beauty Of Failure** A talk exploring how failure drives learning, innovation, and long-term business success. Grounded in academic research across different disciplines and real-world examples, it reframes mistakes as a critical part of organisational performance—not the opposite of it. Refined over years of “failure”, this talk incorporates real stories from participants from all around the world and across diverse professional backgrounds—making each session unique and turning it into a live, interactive conversation. It builds on three core norms that turn mistakes into a fundamental driver of progress—while equipping attendees with practical tools they can apply immediately, regardless of role, sector, or organisational context, to fail in a more meaningful way. 🗓️ Agenda 17:55 check-in 18:00 open bar with drinks 🍻 18:25 foreword by cohosts André Marquet & Bia Raposo 18:30 talk by Beatriz Rovaris 19:00 talk by Guida Marques Pinto 19:30 networking and snacks 21:00 event closure 🙌 Why attend * Participate in an open conversation that can change your career * Network with like-minded professionals in a relaxed atmosphere. * Grab [20% discounted tickets](https://ti.to/productized/conf2026/discount/TALKS20) to Productized Conf 2026. 🎟️ Spots are limited! Secure yours now. Please let us know if you wish to attend but do not want to be featured in any pictures.
